column5: F: Can't a quick script do this? | M: A script written by feel is blind to size. This file says millimetres. | F: So? | M: Believe it, and the house is eighty centimetres wide. column5: F: So where did you adapt? | M: A real drawing taught us three rules. A partition broke a wall line, so pieces now join across small gaps. Porch beams looked like walls, so decking is marked and left out. | F: So you improvise? | M: No. A rule changes when a drawing proves it. A value is never made up.
